body_lead: Strap: Fisheries Minister Nitesh Rane says technology-led pond mapping and desilting could help raise fish output across the State The Maharashtra government plans to deploy artificial intelligence (AI) technology to strengthen freshwater fisheries production by mapping ponds and improving water body management across the State. Fisheries Development Minister Nitesh Rane informed the Legislative Assembly on Friday that the State has begun compiling data on ponds using AI-based tools.
